protocol.scope: Exploratory follow-up on the already inspected public-code cohort
protocol.fit_patients: Only seven original validation patients per outer split; original 21 numerical-training patients and seven test patients are separate
protocol.sample_weights: Equal total weight for each validation patient
protocol.tuning: No test-driven tuning or hyperparameter search; one fixed L2 logistic configuration
limitations: Validation patients also supported original numerical early stopping
This cohort was already inspected; results are exploratory
Response features are summaries and ranks, not validated physiological mechanisms

checks: Validation local indices mapped to actual patient IDs
Manual logistic prediction replay from saved coefficients
Label-free public/tool schemas and exact contact alignment

protocol.scope: Exploratory first-repeat study: 35 patients, seven held-out per fold; old cohort already inspected
protocol.aggregation: Mean of the final four policy score states for every arm
protocol.primary_contrast: multi_independent_first minus multi_serial, with identical model schedule and observations
protocol.isolation: First four independent-first prompts have empty boards; later prompts see all earlier states. No-exchange never sees another proposal.
protocol.tool_arm_caveat: Tool arms bundle equal fixed tool calls with executable-scorer selection; comparison with manual vectors does not isolate tool access alone
protocol.failures: Invalid responses consume attempts and carry a visible prior state or shared baseline. Transport failures halt; resume never repeats spent attempts.
protocol.single_definition: One logical generalist with the same model routing and serial memory as the specialists; mixed routing uses four calls to each provider
protocol.model_control: Argon-only is a separate control study and must not be presented as the requested Argon/Nemotron mixture
protocol.tool_budget: Tool arms each execute eight cached-measurement/scorer CLI queries via native SkillExecutor; identical scorer/reliability access from the first step
